name: kb_maintenance
description: Research KB skill: scheduled maintenance for the six team-level overview pages from the existing Gitea-backed knowledge base, with OpenClaw-led inspection and reasoning, strict overview-only validation, catalog/index maintenance, hidden maintenance status files for frontend display, and no backend scheduling dependency.
input: Optional backend or manual payload JSON. OpenClaw cron runs may omit payload and rely on environment variables.
output: apply writes changed overview pages, catalog/index, .kb/maintenance/kb_maintenance_status.json, and .kb/maintenance/kb_maintenance_runs.json. Successful cron runs can be quiet; failures should call record-failure so frontend status does not stay stale, while command errors still print diagnostics.
